headline: Australia Consumer Price Index Rises Above Expectations as RBA Maintains Restrictive Stance
summary: Australia's consumer price index and underlying inflation came in higher than expected, leading officials to note that financial conditions remain restrictive amid accelerating price pressures.
why: Higher-than-expected inflation metrics force central banks to maintain or tighten monetary policy, directly impacting domestic borrowing costs and currency valuations.

impacts.name: S&P/ASX 200
impacts.why: Hotter-than-expected inflation data raises concerns over monetary tightening.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Hotter consumer inflation data increased expectations that monetary policy will remain restrictive, putting downward pressure on risk assets.
